runs.summary: The cart is easy to scan, but the delivery cost shows up too late and the checkout button competes with promos.

personas.verdict: Understands the cart, unsure what the final price will be.

points.text: Item rows show image, name and price in one glance.
Delivery fee only appears on the next screen.
Show an estimated total under the item list.

personas.verdict: Fast to edit, but no way to save the cart for later.

points.text: Quantity stepper is right next to the price.
Add Save for later on each row.

personas.verdict: Mostly fine; two contrast issues and a small target.

points.text: Grey helper text on the cream card is 3.1:1.

personas.verdict: Promo banner may cut checkout conversion.

points.text: The promo banner sits between the list and Checkout.
Move promos into the empty cart state.
